1	"""Flask API for task management.
2	
3	Storage is flat-file (JSON), not a database — see storage.py.
4	
5	Endpoints under /tasks require a valid JWT (see /auth/register and
6	/auth/login). Each user only sees and manages their own tasks.
7	"""
8	
9	import os
10	from datetime import datetime, timedelta
11	from functools import wraps
12	
13	import jwt
14	from flask import Flask, g, jsonify, request
15	from werkzeug.security import check_password_hash, generate_password_hash
16	
17	import storage
18	from tasks import send_notification_email
19	
20	JWT_ALGORITHM = "HS256"
21	JWT_EXP_HOURS = 24
22	
23	
24	def create_app():
25	    app = Flask(__name__)
26	    storage.init_storage()
27	
28	    app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"] = os.environ.get(
29	        "JWT_SECRET_KEY", "dev-secret-key-change-in-production-32bytes-min"
30	    )
31	
32	    def generate_token(user):
33	        payload = {
34	            "sub": str(user["id"]),
35	            "username": user["username"],
36	            "exp": datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(hours=JWT_EXP_HOURS),
37	        }
38	        return jwt.encode(payload, app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"], algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM)
39	
40	    def require_auth(f):
41	        @wraps(f)
42	        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
43	            auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
44	            if not auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
45	                return jsonify({"error": "Missing or invalid Authorization header"}), 401
46	
47	            token = auth_header[len("Bearer "):].strip()
48	            if not token:
49	                return jsonify({"error": "Missing or invalid Authorization header"}), 401
50	
51	            try:
52	                payload = jwt.decode(
53	                    token, app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"], algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM]
54	                )
55	            except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
56	                return jsonify({"error": "Token expired"}), 401
57	            except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
58	                return jsonify({"error": "Invalid token"}), 401
59	
60	            g.user_id = int(payload["sub"])
61	            g.username = payload.get("username")
62	            return f(*args, **kwargs)
63	
64	        return wrapper
65	
66	    @app.errorhandler(404)
67	    def not_found(_e):
68	        return jsonify({"error": "Not found"}), 404
69	
70	    @app.errorhandler(405)
71	    def method_not_allowed(_e):
72	        return jsonify({"error": "Method not allowed"}), 405
73	
74	    @app.route("/auth/register", methods=["POST"])
75	    def register():
76	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
77	        username = data.get("username")
78	        password = data.get("password")
79	
80	        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username.strip():
81	            return jsonify({"error": "username is required"}), 400
82	        if not isinstance(password, str) or not password:
83	            return jsonify({"error": "password is required"}), 400
84	
85	        password_hash = generate_password_hash(password)
86	        user = storage.create_user(username.strip(), password_hash)
87	        if user is None:
88	            return jsonify({"error": "username already exists"}), 409
89	
90	        return jsonify({"id": user["id"], "username": user["username"]}), 201
91	
92	    @app.route("/auth/login", methods=["POST"])
93	    def login():
94	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
95	        username = data.get("username")
96	        password = data.get("password")
97	
98	        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username.strip():
99	            return jsonify({"error": "username is required"}), 400
100	        if not isinstance(password, str) or not password:
101	            return jsonify({"error": "password is required"}), 400
102	
103	        user = storage.get_user_by_username(username.strip())
104	        if user is None or not check_password_hash(user["password_hash"], password):
105	            return jsonify({"error": "invalid username or password"}), 401
106	
107	        token = generate_token(user)
108	        return jsonify({"token": token}), 200
109	
110	    @app.route("/tasks", methods=["POST"])
111	    @require_auth
112	    def create_task():
113	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
114	        title = data.get("title")
115	        if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip():
116	            return jsonify({"error": "title is required"}), 400
117	        task = storage.create_task(title.strip(), g.user_id)
118	        return jsonify(task), 201
119	
120	    @app.route("/tasks", methods=["GET"])
121	    @require_auth
122	    def list_tasks():
123	        return jsonify(storage.list_tasks(g.user_id)), 200
124	
125	    @app.route("/tasks/<int:task_id>", methods=["GET"])
126	    @require_auth
127	    def get_task(task_id):
128	        task = storage.get_task(task_id)
129	        if task is None or task.get("owner_id") != g.user_id:
130	            return jsonify({"error": "Task not found"}), 404
131	        return jsonify(task), 200
132	
133	    @app.route("/tasks/<int:task_id>", methods=["PUT"])
134	    @require_auth
135	    def update_task(task_id):
136	        existing = storage.get_task(task_id)
137	        if existing is None or existing.get("owner_id") != g.user_id:
138	            return jsonify({"error": "Task not found"}), 404
139	
140	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
141	        has_title = "title" in data
142	        has_status = "status" in data
143	        if not has_title and not has_status:
144	            return jsonify({"error": "title or status is required"}), 400
145	
146	        title = data.get("title")
147	        if has_title and (not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip()):
148	            return jsonify({"error": "title must be a non-empty string"}), 400
149	
150	        status = data.get("status")
151	        if has_status and (not isinstance(status, str) or not status.strip()):
152	            return jsonify({"error": "status must be a non-empty string"}), 400
153	
154	        task = storage.update_task(
155	            task_id,
156	            title=title.strip() if has_title else None,
157	            status=status.strip() if has_status else None,
158	        )
159	
160	        newly_completed = (
161	            has_status
162	            and status.strip() == "completed"
163	            and existing.get("status") != "completed"
164	        )
165	        if newly_completed:
166	            owner = storage.get_user_by_id(task["owner_id"])
167	            if owner is not None:
168	                owner_email = owner.get("email") or f"{owner['username']}@example.com"
169	                try:
170	                    send_notification_email.delay(owner_email, task["title"])
171	                except Exception:
172	                    app.logger.exception("Failed to enqueue completion notification email")
173	
174	        return jsonify(task), 200
175	
176	    return app
177	
178	
179	app = create_app()
180	
181	if __name__ == "__main__":
182	    app.run(debug=True)

1	"""Flat-file (JSON) storage layer for tasks and users. No database engine is
2	used — all data lives in a single JSON file on disk, guarded by an
3	in-process lock plus atomic write-and-replace to avoid partial/corrupt
4	writes."""
5	
6	import json
7	import os
8	import threading
9	from datetime import datetime
10	
11	_lock = threading.Lock()
12	
13	DEFAULT_FILE = os.path.join(
14	    os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "data", "tasks.json"
15	)
16	
17	
18	def get_storage_file():
19	    return os.environ.get("TASKS_FILE", DEFAULT_FILE)
20	
21	
22	def init_storage():
23	    path = get_storage_file()
24	    directory = os.path.dirname(path)
25	    if directory:
26	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
27	    if not os.path.exists(path):
28	        _write({"next_id": 1, "tasks": [], "next_user_id": 1, "users": []})
29	        return
30	
31	    with _lock:
32	        data = _read()
33	        changed = False
34	        if "users" not in data:
35	            data["users"] = []
36	            changed = True
37	        if "next_user_id" not in data:
38	            data["next_user_id"] = 1
39	            changed = True
40	        for task in data.get("tasks", []):
41	            if "owner_id" not in task:
42	                task["owner_id"] = None
43	                changed = True
44	        if changed:
45	            _write(data)
46	
47	
48	def _read():
49	    path = get_storage_file()
50	    with open(path, "r") as f:
51	        return json.load(f)
52	
53	
54	def _write(data):
55	    path = get_storage_file()
56	    tmp_path = f"{path}.tmp"
57	    with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
58	        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
59	    os.replace(tmp_path, path)
60	
61	
62	def create_task(title, owner_id):
63	    with _lock:
64	        data = _read()
65	        task = {
66	            "id": data["next_id"],
67	            "title": title,
68	            "status": "pending",
69	            "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
70	            "owner_id": owner_id,
71	        }
72	        data["tasks"].append(task)
73	        data["next_id"] += 1
74	        _write(data)
75	        return task
76	
77	
78	def list_tasks(owner_id):
79	    data = _read()
80	    tasks = [t for t in data["tasks"] if t.get("owner_id") == owner_id]
81	    return sorted(tasks, key=lambda t: (t["created_at"], t["id"]), reverse=True)
82	
83	
84	def get_task(task_id):
85	    data = _read()
86	    for task in data["tasks"]:
87	        if task["id"] == task_id:
88	            return task
89	    return None
90	
91	
92	def update_task(task_id, title=None, status=None):
93	    with _lock:
94	        data = _read()
95	        for task in data["tasks"]:
96	            if task["id"] == task_id:
97	                if title is not None:
98	                    task["title"] = title
99	                if status is not None:
100	                    task["status"] = status
101	                _write(data)
102	                return task
103	        return None
104	
105	
106	def create_user(username, password_hash):
107	    with _lock:
108	        data = _read()
109	        for user in data["users"]:
110	            if user["username"] == username:
111	                return None
112	        user = {
113	            "id": data["next_user_id"],
114	            "username": username,
115	            "password_hash": password_hash,
116	        }
117	        data["users"].append(user)
118	        data["next_user_id"] += 1
119	        _write(data)
120	        return user
121	
122	
123	def get_user_by_username(username):
124	    data = _read()
125	    for user in data["users"]:
126	        if user["username"] == username:
127	            return user
128	    return None
129	
130	
131	def get_user_by_id(user_id):
132	    data = _read()
133	    for user in data["users"]:
134	        if user["id"] == user_id:
135	            return user
136	    return None

1	"""Celery tasks for the task management API."""
2	
3	import logging

5	from celery_app import celery_app
6	
7	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
8

10	@celery_app.task(name="tasks.send_notification_email")
11	def send_notification_email(user_email, task_title):
12	    """Mock-send a "task completed" notification email.
13	
14	    Real mail delivery isn't wired up; this logs/prints the message so the
15	    async dispatch path can be exercised end-to-end without a mail provider.
16	    """
17	    message = (
18	        f"[email] To: {user_email} | Subject: Task completed | "
19	        f"Body: Your task '{task_title}' is now complete."
20	    )
21	    logger.info(message)
22	    print(message)
23	    return message
